steps.description:
Equity in engineering means designing things so that everyone, no matter their age or ability, can use them safely and fairly.

Equity in engineering is gaining attention not only as a real-world problem-solving approach but also as a theme in competitions, particularly those centered on student innovation. A widely seen example in Singapore is the Green Man+ pedestrian traffic light system.


Green Man+ is an initiative by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) that addresses the needs of elderly pedestrians and persons with disabilities (PWDs) who may require more time to cross the road.

Pedestrian traffic lights with Green Man+ have two triggers: the usual button and a card tap. Tapping a valid card, typically used by the elderly or persons with disabilities, activates a green man signal that lasts longer than the standard timing triggered by the button.



Referring to the table below, write a code to simulate part of the Green Man+ pedestrian traffic lights.


Card tap will take priority over button press if both happen together. The program should keep running.
